name: Massachusetts

agency.name: Massachusetts Department of Environmental Protection (MassDEP)
agency.division: Bureau of Air and Waste; MassDEP regional offices

overview: MassDEP requires a Plan Approval before constructing or modifying facilities that emit air contaminants (310 CMR 7.02), as a Limited Plan Application (LPA) or Comprehensive Plan Application (CPA) depending on size, unless exempt. Alternatives include Permit-by-Rule (310 CMR 7.03) and the mandatory Environmental Results Program (ERP, 310 CMR 7.26) for certain sectors. All new units must meet BACT (or LAER where nonattainment NSR applies). Major sources need a Title V Operating Permit under 310 CMR 7.00 Appendix C. MassDEP administers PSD by EPA delegation under 40 CFR 52.21.

permitTypes.name: Permit-by-Rule
permitTypes.description: Performance standards, recordkeeping, and caps as an alternative to Plan Approval for degreasers, wave solder, lead melt pots, paint spray booths, fuel cells, welding, and others; report installations in the next Source Registration.

permitTypes.name: Environmental Results Program (ERP)
permitTypes.description: Mandatory sector-wide performance standards and compliance certifications replacing Plan Approvals for covered categories, such as certain new gas/ULSD boilers, emergency and non-emergency engines, printing, perc dry cleaning, outdoor wood-fired hydronic heaters, and small turbines. If installing a boiler would make a facility subject to Title V (310 CMR 7.00 Appendix C), nonattainment review, or PSD, 310 CMR 7.26(30)(b) sets out the owner's options.

permitTypes.name: Plan Approval: Limited Plan Application (LPA) / Comprehensive Plan Application (CPA)
permitTypes.description: Preconstruction approval requiring BACT for all LPA and CPA approvals, and compliance with 310 CMR 7.00 standards and NAAQS. 310 CMR 7.02(4) and (5) also set fuel utilization unit capacity triggers. Plan approvals are valid for the life of the emission unit, and MassDEP may revoke one if construction has not commenced within two years (310 CMR 7.02(3)(k) and (l)).
permitTypes.quote: An LPA is required from any person prior to constructing, substantially reconstructing, altering, or subsequently operating any facility or emission unit described as follows: ... Any facility where the construction, substantial reconstruction, alteration or subsequent operation would result in an increase in potential emissions of a single air contaminant equal to or greater than one ton per year and less than ten tons per year, calculated over any consecutive 12-month time period. ... A CPA is required from any person prior to constructing, substantially reconstructing, altering or subsequently operating any facility or emission unit as follows: ... Any facility where the construction, substantial reconstruction, alteration or subsequent operation would result in an increase in potential emissions of a single air contaminant equal to or greater than ten tons per year, calculated over any consecutive 12-month time period.

quoteSource.name: 310 CMR 7.00 (official text, Secretary of the Commonwealth), part 1

permitTypes.name: PSD
permitTypes.description: Administered by MassDEP under a PSD delegation agreement with EPA Region 1, implementing 40 CFR 52.21.

permitTypes.name: Nonattainment NSR
permitTypes.description: Major emissions in nonattainment areas; LAER and offsets under 310 CMR 7.00 Appendix A, Emission Offsets and Nonattainment Review.

permitTypes.name: Title V Operating Permit
permitTypes.description: For listed source categories or facilities above thresholds; apply within one year of starting operations (MassDEP recommends filing with the Plan Application).

oilAndGas.summary: Massachusetts has no oil and gas production. MassDEP's permitting guidance lists no oil-and-gas-specific air program.

notes: Plan Approval applicability quoted from the current 310 CMR 7.02 published by the Secretary of the Commonwealth; permit-by-rule, ERP, and Appendix A and C titles confirmed in the same text; PSD delegation confirmed in EPA Region 1's agreement (2026-10-31). Program descriptions also draw on MassDEP's Plan Approval overview. Title V thresholds are in 310 CMR 7.00 Appendix C and are not restated here.
